verdict.rationale: Calendly documents registrable webhook subscriptions (create, list, delete, sample data) that push payloads to your endpoint in real time when invitees schedule or cancel. Reschedules fire both `invitee.created` and `invitee.canceled`. The docs also cover signing keys for verification and 24-hour exponential-backoff retries. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of delivery reliability, and a distinct reschedule event type (reschedules surface as a created/canceled pair).
